findings.entity: The trucker's rig outside the diner
findings.description: The rig the driver walks to and opens at 01:43-01:49 (dark-green day-cab tractor with box trailer) does not match the rig established in the opening shot 00:00-00:10 (white sleeper-cab tractor with long dry-van trailer, idling/steaming, clearly coded as his). No shot shows the original rig leaving or a different rig arriving, so the vehicle he uses at the end has no consistent origin across shots; the established prop was silently replaced with a different vehicle of the same general category.
